owner_request: 看 5min 级别的，到关键点位，只做插针收回的
design: Preregistered single 5m wick-reclaim filter on the frozen first-contact cohort; primary pooled reclaim 60m, family/side strata with BH correction.
single_variable: Add strict same-5m wick-through-and-reclaim confirmation. To isolate selection from entry delay, recompute ALL first contacts at the same next-5m-open clock as the filter. Preserve v1 first-contact scope, level definitions, date split, cost, horizons and random seeds.
profile_volume: Archive volume is contracts; multiply by 0.01 for BTC base-volume units. A constant multiplier cancels analytically; compare both units for floating-point boundary differences and retain the count. No volume-based signal is fitted.
entry: Long: the first-touch complete 5m candle opens strictly above the level, trades strictly below, and closes strictly above. Short is symmetric. Confirm at 5m close, measure from following 5m open. No wick/body or penetration threshold. No repeated later retests.
lifetime: Frozen Monday levels: Tuesday to next Monday; previous-week extremes: current calendar week; yesterday VAH/VAL: one day. Each session POC: first touch within next 14 calendar days; classify as yesterday_poc on day 1, otherwise npoc. This prevents duplicate yesterday POC / nPOC events.
missing: Inherit audited continuous first-contact paths; require complete 5m signal candle and next open plus continuous 4h outcome. No interpolation and no split-crossing labels.

controls.match: Same BTC/NY week/6h local daypart/causal vol tertile/last completed 15m momentum sign/side/split. Random entries only at 5m opens with a complete preceding 5m candle. Features known before that candle opens. Same horizons and 0.2% cost. Exclude +/-4h from event; sample without replacement per event; reuse across events allowed and retained.
controls.volatility: Unchanged 96-return 15m std and preceding 30-day tertile thresholds, minimum 7 days, all known BEFORE the signal 5m candle opens.

statistics.test: Unchanged week-cluster sign flip and bootstrap of event-minus-control means. BH q over all primary-60m family/side groups within period AND cohort. Only wick_reclaim is the primary hypothesis cohort; all_contacts_5m_clock and not_reclaim are descriptive comparators. No direct causal claim from the filtered-minus-unfiltered mean.
statistics.success: No live promotion. A promising family must have positive 60m net and positive excess in both chronological periods, with p<0.01 and q<0.01 in each; no selecting a different horizon after results.

not_applicable: No learned model or ranking: AUC, class prevalence and top-decile metrics are not applicable. Fixed-horizon returns and matched random controls are measured. MFE/MAE are descriptive extrema, not realized exit profits.
limitations: First-touch events only; does not test every subsequent retest, multi-candle reclaim, a wick/body-ratio rule, resting limit fills or a TP/SL strategy. Same-bar reclaim is known only at its close. No queue, orderbook, funding, position sizing or portfolio equity. Overlapping levels are clustered by week. Pre/post are chronological replication, not untouched holdouts.
